external_research_delta.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere 2025, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs, arXiv:2505.20896
external_research_delta.observed: The studied Transformer had to dereference assignment chains up to four steps with distractor chains, and passed through a shallow early-assignment heuristic before systematic binding emerged.
dataset_or_eval_change: add depth-2/3/4 binding-chain curriculum and frozen depth-4 OOD slice
randomize assignment order and target location
add hard negatives where the earliest or nearest assignment is wrong but a later chained binding is correct
track depth-conditioned accuracy so a shallow heuristic cannot hide under aggregate score

external_research_delta.source: Bertalanic and Fortuna 2026, The Cost of Consensus, arXiv:2605.00914
external_research_delta.observed: In the reported homogeneous N=10 debate setting, conformity and consensus collapse can make debate more costly than isolated self-correction.
dataset_or_eval_change: add isolated-self-correction as a matched-budget GRID10 challenger
train/evaluate disagreement preservation rather than unconditional peer adoption
add correct-minority versus wrong-majority trajectories with ancestry-aware retention

external_research_delta.source: Yan et al. 2026, When Truth Is Distributed, arXiv:2608.03421
external_research_delta.observed: A single false testimony can propagate through homogeneous multi-agent communication and persist after the original source exits.
dataset_or_eval_change: add root-evidence-lineage tracking to consensus hard negatives
count copied testimony as one ancestry branch rather than independent corroboration
require an evidence-bearing discriminator before Hyperposition collapse when many nodes inherit one root claim

swarm_review_roles.finding: Binding curriculum remains a model-facing primitive inside Xeno/HCU; it must not replace boot/join/state/lease/Hyperposition/GWT/EffectGate training families.
No Qwen3.5 positive J-Space control label is created. Qwen3-0.6B causal/vector evidence remains cross-model methodology only.
A correct class-to-atom permutation can still leak through fixed codebook line order. Position must be independently counterbalanced and audited.
Binding evaluation must distinguish shallow assignment heuristics from true chained dereference by depth, distractors, and assignment-order interventions.
Ten identical checkpoints are not ten independent evidence sources. Root ancestry and matched isolated-self-correction baselines are mandatory.
Single-token atom claims must be regenerated for exact tokenizer bytes; tokenizer-family similarity cannot establish the property.
Do not broaden primary training toward semantics, HRR/MAP algebra, or generic world knowledge while measured binding/routing remains the dominant gap.
